item.title: Response to the Green victory in Gorton and Denton by-election - Greenpeace UK

item.title: Three lessons for Labour from the Gorton and Denton by-election - Greenpeace UK
item.description: Labour just lost a safe seat to a Green Party candidate who won on climate, nature, and economic justice. The message is clear: billionaire-backed climate denial has a ceiling, and voters want bolder politics.

item.description: Greenpeace UK has urged the government to implement plans to decouple the cost of electricity from gas amid a huge spike in gas prices triggered by the US-Israeli bombing of Iran.
